build_GRN_module: build a GRN module with given in_channels to apply Global Response Normalization on 4D tensors
build_LayerNorm2d_module: build a LayerNorm2d module for applying Layer Normalization on 2D image tensors with channel support
build_norm_layer_from_cfg: build a normalization layer from a config dict specifying type and arguments for num_features
test_GRN_forward: test the GRN forward pass with channel_first and channel_last data format inputs
test_LayerNorm2d_forward: test the LayerNorm2d forward pass on 4D tensors in both channel_first and channel_last formats
